segments.name: Broadband
segments.description: Provides software-based broadband access solutions and related services enabling broadband operators globally to deliver high-speed internet, data, voice and video services.
segments.evidence: Our Broadband business provides broadband access solutions and related services, including our cOS software-based broadband access solution, to broadband operators globally.

revenueModel.text: Broadband operators worldwide pay Harmonic for broadband access solutions, including appliance and integration products and SaaS and related services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue has been derived from worldwide sales to broadband service providers.

changes.text: In 2025, Harmonic agreed to sell its Video business to Leone Media Inc. (d/b/a MediaKind), leaving Broadband as its single reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Following the classification of the Video business as discontinued operations, the Company's continuing operations now consist of a single reportable segment, Broadband.
